sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example is written more briefly. Fill in the reasoning it leaves out.

items.prompt: Write the equation, in slope-intercept form, of a line with slope -2 and y-intercept 5.

steps: Slope-intercept form is y = mx + b.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Identify the slope and y-intercept of the line y = (-5/2)x + 11.

Relationship A: y = (9/5)x
Relationship B (proportional):
x: 1, 2, 3
y: 5, 10, 15
By how much does the greater rate of change exceed the lesser rate of change?
For the line y = 7x + 13, find y when x = -15.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line has equation y = -5x - 5. Which of these equations represents a line parallel to it?
A line has equation y = (-1/2)x + 2. Write the equation of the line through (-4, 11) that is parallel to this line.
A taxi fare is given by F = 3m + 23, where F is the total fare in dollars and m is the number of miles traveled. What does the slope represent in this context?
choices: The fare increases by $23 for each additional mile traveled.
There is a base fare of $23 before any miles are traveled.
The fare increases by $3 for each additional mile traveled.
There is a base fare of $3 before any miles are traveled.

items.prompt: A moving company's total cost is given by C = 23h + 10, where C is the total cost in dollars and h is the number of hours of labor. What does the y-intercept represent in this context?
choices: The company charges a flat fee of $23 before any labor hours.
The company charges $10 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges $23 for each additional hour of labor.
The company charges a flat fee of $10 before any labor hours.

items.prompt: Find the slope of the line through (-20, -6) and (5, -26).

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt:
A line passes through these points:
x: -20, -16, -12, -8
y: 10, 5, 0, -5
What is the slope (rate of change) of the line?

A line passes through (10, -12). A slope triangle on the line has a horizontal leg (run) of 5 and a vertical leg (rise) of 6. A similar slope triangle further along the same line is 3 times as large. Which point also lies on the line?
